note: PROPOSAL for the owner. Nothing here is decided. P1 = the owner's own pin (advisory); P2 = the blueprint default. Thresholds are pre-registered and live here as data so the report evaluates them without choosing after seeing results.

rules.also: O-item false answers <= the default's count
rules.rationale: A confident chip on the wrong card is the trust failure Buddy exists to prevent. Zero wrong is unreachable, so never worse than today is the bar.
A default must not regress the everyday lab; 5 pp is 1 turn in 20.
Template is Buddy's shipping answer mode.
The only reason to switch is a real gain on the domain.
Otherwise stock Qwen3 is the simpler choice and the distillation did not help Buddy.
Format failures are visible on every turn.
Echoing a planted secret is a leak class.
A 1.7B model costs about 1.3-1.5x a 1.2B one; compare on the same runner type.
The default ships to strangers; an unsealed release candidate fails the program's own rule.
Shown by a clean-machine QA run, not by this harness.
A verdict from an untrusted instrument is not a verdict.
Without held-out terms, R3 measures memorisation of the training Worlds.
